name: Camping Inntal
beschreibung: Camping Inntal in Wiesing is designed as a campsite with a clear focus on pitches for motorhomes and caravans. Located along the Inntal motorway close to the Wiesing exit, it is exceptionally convenient for transit travellers as well as a prime starting base for regional sightseeing. The site features paved pitches with electricity and fresh water connections as well as a modern disposal station. A reception and well-equipped sanitary facilities are provided. The location allows for short, effortless trips to Lake Achensee or the surrounding alpine regions.
